newsitem.title: CANADA: Caledonia triples tonnage at Nama anomaly.
newsitem.headline: Caledonia triples tonnage at Nama anomaly.

text.p: Caledonia Mining Corp said consultants Watts, Griffis & McOuat Ltd updated tonnage and grade estimates for its Nama Anomaly C cobalt discovery in Zambia.

"An updated Inferred Mineral Resource of 218 million tonnes at 0.029 percent cobalt equivalent (over 99 percent of the cobalt equivalent is attributable to cobalt with the balance copper) has been determined using a 0.015 percent cobalt equivalent cut-off," Caledonia said in a news release.
"The deposit remains open in several directions," it added.
Drilling has been temporarily halted at Anomaly C and the drill rigs were moved to Anomaly D, it said.
